_comment: Every spoken line, by id. Scene A, the balcony and the random conversations are the owner's, verbatim. Lines marked NEW are this build's and are for the owner to rewrite. socko_face / socko_clip / socko_talk cue Socko's performance (scripts/art/socko_clips.gd).

door_1.speaker: kurt
door_1.text: Ms. Sokolov? Your sister asked me to come check on you.

door_2.speaker: kurt
door_2.text: Marta? It's Kurt. I'm coming in.

boxes.speaker: marta
boxes.text: Little boxes made of boxes with boxes inside of them... Have you seen them? The boxes, I mean. They're scary at first. But then you look at them for a moment

little_bird.speaker: marta
little_bird.text: Look at the boxes, my little bird. Do you see them?

hey_buddy.speaker: socko
hey_buddy.text: Heyyyy buddyyyy.... You should probably take it slow, a concussion is no joke!

who_are_you.speaker: kurt
who_are_you.text: Yeah, you. Who the fuck are you?

im_socko.speaker: socko
im_socko.text: I'm Socko! I'm a handy little pal! Who are you?

too_fast.speaker: socko
too_fast.text: Shouldn't have stood up so fast.

thanks.speaker: kurt
thanks.text: Wow, thanks. I never would have guessed.

can_do_this.speaker: socko
can_do_this.text: I know that I can do this!

smell.speaker: socko
smell.text: Ooh! Ooh! And I can smell important stuff! Go this way!

bal_3.speaker: kurt
bal_3.text: To my recollection, typically there's more to the world than a sticky note that says "outside"

bal_4.speaker: socko
bal_4.text: I wouldn't know, I'm more of an indoor person

ra_1.speaker: kurt
ra_1.text: Hey, uh, Socko. I have a question.

ra_4.speaker: socko
ra_4.text: Wow, what a great question, Kurt! When a mommy sock puppet and a daddy sock puppet love each other very much, they...

rb_1.speaker: socko
rb_1.text: Hey, Kurt, can I ask you a question?

rc_1.speaker: socko
rc_1.text: Kurt, have you ever had a sandwich?

rc_4b.speaker: kurt
rc_4b.text: There's lots of different kinds of sandwiches, buddy. I'm gonna need you to be more specific.

_comment_socko: Socko's lines past Scene A are NEW (this build's), for the owner to rewrite. Stages: 1 friendly, 2 confused, 3 insistent, 4 passive-aggressive, 5 irritated, 6 manipulative, 7 hostile.

sug_wardrobe_a.speaker: socko
sug_wardrobe_a.text: Ooh, that wardrobe looks heavy. Heavy things are fun to push!

sug_gun_a.speaker: socko
sug_gun_a.text: I can smell it from here, buddy. Something shiny. This way!

sug_gun_b.speaker: socko
sug_gun_b.text: The shiny thing. Still that way. Still shiny.

sug_gun_c.speaker: socko
sug_gun_c.text: Every second you're not holding it, she's getting closer. Just so you know.

sug_marta_a.speaker: socko
sug_marta_a.text: She's around here somewhere. You've got a gun. I'm just saying things that are true!

sug_marta_b.speaker: socko
sug_marta_b.text: You know what fixes a problem like her? Seven of the things in your pocket.

sug_marta_c.speaker: socko
sug_marta_c.text: She'd do it to you, Kurt. She already did. Look at your head.

sug_marta_d.speaker: socko
sug_marta_d.text: Kill her. Kill her kill her kill her. What part of that is hard?

sug_door_a.speaker: socko
sug_door_a.text: Locked doors are just doors that need a little encouragement!

sug_padlock_a.speaker: socko
sug_padlock_a.text: Shoot the lock. Takes two seconds. I timed it. In my head.

sug_padlock_b.speaker: socko
sug_padlock_b.text: Or we could stand here. Or. We could shoot it.

sug_exit_a.speaker: socko
sug_exit_a.text: There's a way out, bud. There's always a way out. Sometimes it's through somebody.

sug_none_a.speaker: socko
sug_none_a.text: Let's keep moving! Moving is good. Standing still is how things find you.

sug_none_c.speaker: socko
sug_none_c.text: I'd tell you, but you don't listen.

gun_taken.speaker: socko
gun_taken.text: Ooh. Now we're talking. You know what that's for.

reloaded.speaker: socko
reloaded.text: Look at you go. Did you see your hands? I didn't teach you that.

read_a.speaker: socko
read_a.text: Don't read other people's mail, buddy.

read_c.speaker: socko
read_c.text: Reading. Again. Great. Love that for us.

memory_skill.speaker: socko
memory_skill.text: ...Really? That? Okay. Your shards. Your memories. Whatever.

infection_skill.speaker: socko
infection_skill.text: There we go. Now we're friends.

headshot_skill.speaker: socko
headshot_skill.text: Ooh, good choice. Great choice. The best choice.

kill_marta_2.speaker: socko
kill_marta_2.text: What? It's a... word. Come on.

calm_one.speaker: socko
calm_one.text: No. No no no. What are you doing? She was RIGHT THERE.

calm_two.speaker: socko
calm_two.text: ...Fine. Your way. Your slow, slow way.

calm_forever.speaker: socko
calm_forever.text: She's still in there, you know. In case you were wondering. Gun works fine on sad people.

talked_down.speaker: socko
talked_down.text: You know you can't talk to all of them, right? Eventually one of them talks back.

shocked.speaker: socko
shocked.text: OW. Okay. Water and electricity. Noted. NOTED.

marta_shocked.speaker: socko
marta_shocked.text: Huh. That's one way. Not MY way, but a way.

caught_marta.speaker: socko
caught_marta.text: Up. Up. She's had her go. Now we have ours.

caught_super.speaker: socko
caught_super.text: Okay, so, the big guy. Let's not do that again.

figures_2.speaker: socko
figures_2.text: Don't let them get close enough to surprise you. Or. You know. Take care of it.

tv.speaker: socko
tv.text: Ooh, TV! Nothing like a little noise to bring the neighbours round.

bath_black.speaker: socko
bath_black.text: Your hand went in that. Your hand. Which is next to ME.

hurt.speaker: socko
hurt.text: You're leaking, buddy. Maybe stop doing that.

fell_white.speaker: socko
fell_white.text: ...and we're back! Outside's overrated. I said that. I'm an indoor person.

warn_marta.speaker: socko
warn_marta.text: Shh. Shh shh shh. Something's close.

stage2.speaker: socko
stage2.text: Huh? Oh. Okay. We're doing it like that. Okay!

stage3.speaker: socko
stage3.text: Buddy. Buddy. Buddy. The gun. The gun, buddy.

stage4.speaker: socko
stage4.text: No, no, take your time. It's not like anything in here wants to eat us.

stage5.speaker: socko
stage5.text: Why don't you EVER listen to me?

stage6.speaker: socko
stage6.text: I'm scared, Kurt. I'm just a sock. If you die, I die. Don't you care about me at all?

stage7.speaker: socko
stage7.text: I made you. Do you understand that? I MADE you.

cmd_poke.speaker: socko
cmd_poke.text: Poke poke poke! I'm a natural.

cmd_bath.speaker: socko
cmd_bath.text: In THERE? With my FACE? ...Fine. For you.

cmd_bath_ok.speaker: socko
cmd_bath_ok.text: Something hard. Something... shoe-shaped. Can I come out now?

cmd_look.speaker: socko
cmd_look.text: It's dark in there. Darker than dark. I love it.

mx_4.speaker: socko
mx_4.text: Peeba. Nep nep. Wubboo dee doo dah.

mx_k2.speaker: kurt
mx_k2.text: You. And her. You were talking.

tut_move.speaker: socko
tut_move.text: Take it slow. Little steps. Then big steps. Then little steps again!

tut_crouch.speaker: socko
tut_crouch.text: Get low. Lower. There you go. You've done this before, huh?

tut_carry.speaker: socko
tut_carry.text: Ooh, you can carry stuff! And throw stuff. Things that get thrown make noise. Things that make noise make friends.

tut_noise.speaker: socko
tut_noise.text: Hear that? Everything in here hears that.

tut_mantle.speaker: socko
tut_mantle.text: Whoa! Up you go! Where'd you learn that?

cmd_latch.speaker: socko
cmd_latch.text: A fortochka! I love a fortochka. Lift me up, I'll do the latch.

cmd_latch_ok.speaker: socko
cmd_latch_ok.text: Click! I'm a burglar now. Don't tell anyone.

end_out.speaker: socko
end_out.text: See? Easy. Next time we just do it my way.

end_out_kill.speaker: socko
end_out_kill.text: That was fun! Wasn't that fun? Let's do more of that.

end_out_calm.speaker: socko
end_out_calm.text: Shoes. You gave her shoes. Next time, we do it my way.

f48_arrive.speaker: socko
f48_arrive.text: Huh. It's 47. Somebody drew it from memory and ran out of crayons.

f48_close2.speaker: socko
f48_close2.text: Don't let them get close enough to surprise you.

f48_looked.speaker: socko
f48_looked.text: You don't know what they are.

f48_looked2.speaker: socko
f48_looked2.text: Mama. Papa. Child. That's supposed to make this better?

f48_notes.speaker: socko
f48_notes.text: Words. We're sticking words on furniture now.

f48_notes2.speaker: socko
f48_notes2.text: I think you're giving this a little too much attention.

f48_real1.speaker: socko
f48_real1.text: Could be someone wanted you to find all this.

f48_real2.speaker: socko
f48_real2.text: You're looking for reasons to trust them.

f48_safe.speaker: socko
f48_safe.text: Ooh. Now that one I like.

f48_opened.speaker: socko
f48_opened.text: Well, would you look at that. Somebody planned ahead.

f48_gun.speaker: socko
f48_gun.text: Two barrels. That's one each for two of them, and a quick reload.

f48_gun2.speaker: socko
f48_gun2.text: I'm just counting. Somebody has to.

f48_shot2.speaker: socko
f48_shot2.text: I knew you'd figure it out.

f48_shot3.speaker: socko
f48_shot3.text: And that's the family. See? Quiet now.

f48_dress_mama.speaker: socko
f48_dress_mama.text: Huh. Look at that. She cleans up.

f48_dress_papa2.speaker: socko
f48_dress_papa2.text: That's not funny. Who's that supposed to be? Don't answer that.

f48_not_sonya.speaker: socko
f48_not_sonya.text: See? Nothing. Nobody's here. Let's go.

f48_refuse1.speaker: socko
f48_refuse1.text: You're making this harder than it needs to be.

f48_refuse2.speaker: socko
f48_refuse2.text: I thought we were trying to get out of here. We have our own problems.

f48_refuse4.speaker: socko
f48_refuse4.text: What? I didn't say shoot them. When did I say shoot them? I said keep your distance.

stairs_1.speaker: socko
stairs_1.text: Ooh, stairs! Up or down? Down's quicker. Down's always quicker.

bolt_heard.speaker: socko
bolt_heard.text: Did you hear that? Something let go, downstairs.

street_locked.speaker: socko
street_locked.text: Four bolts. You could shoot them. I'm just saying you could.

f51_in.speaker: socko
f51_in.text: Somebody's been here before you. Somebody with your feet.

f51_void.speaker: socko
f51_void.text: There's no wall. Why is there no wall? I liked the wall.

f44_in.speaker: socko
f44_in.text: A corridor. Of rooms. Of chairs. I love chairs.

f44_loop.speaker: socko
f44_loop.text: We've been here. Don't say we haven't been here.

plan_done.speaker: socko
plan_done.text: ...That doesn't mean anything. Notes don't mean anything.

end_street.speaker: socko
end_street.text: Outside. Finally. Hold on to me, bud. Don't let go.

ledge_first.speaker: kurt
ledge_first.text: Back to the wall. Small steps. There's nothing out there to fall onto, and that's worse.

ledge_down.speaker: kurt
ledge_down.text: No street. No ground. Just white, all the way down, and the drainpipe going into it.

ledge_elbow.speaker: kurt
ledge_elbow.text: Ah... Through the sleeve. It'll do.

ledge_reach.speaker: kurt
ledge_reach.text: Arm in up to the shoulder... there. The latch.

ledge_socko.speaker: socko
ledge_socko.text: Ooh, a ledge! Don't look down. I looked down. Don't.

_comment_ledge: NEW (this build): the ledge outside 47's bedroom, and Socko's latch lines. For the owner to rewrite.
